tables.title: Grupo Julio terminology
rows: Supply Chain Architected for Logistics Execution warehouse management.
Client’s ERP system integrating with Scale
Item Identifier for regular inventory. For client, this is item code, style, color, and size.
Global Trade Item Number. Definition of an SKU in a specific Unit of Measurement (UoM).
Goods purchased by Client. Purchase orders and receipts have a 1:M mapping. SCALE maintains these as receipts with PO interfaced on receipt header.
A container or truck being received into the DC. One inbound trailer has one receipt.
Goods to be shipped to stores, wholesale customers, or retail supermarkets. The order in ERP and shipment in scale will be a 1:1 mapping.
A wave represents the different steps that the system uses to retrieve orders from the pool, and process them into the outbound portion of SCALE
a group of orders when processed resulting in inventory allocation
Any orders pending processing to be shipped immediately after interface to SCALE
Transaction tracked by SCALE to coordinate the movement of inventory for a variety of warehouse processes. A group of work instruction is a work unit
An object that can be used to hold or transport inventory for a shipment.
An object that can be used to hold or transport inventory for a receipt.
An object that can be used to hold or transport inventory. When nested, the tree unit is referred to as the parent logistics unit.
Override Data Wave Step. SCALE provides a wave step that allows performing crud operation to data during the wave process.
An external process that performs logic in line with the base process. Used to update data or perform additional logic.
Advanced Shipping Notice. Receipt that contains all information that will be received into the warehouse, including the container IDs.
Returns Merchandise Authorizations. Receipt interfaced into SCALE with the information of the returning items.
Standard Operational Procedure. Documentation containing steps that must be followed to execute a procedure. May include steps executed in different systems and outside of systems.
Put to Light system. Used by Grupo Julio during sorting process.
TA = Temporada Atual (Current Season) TP = Temporada Pasada (Previous Season)

tables.title: Knipper terminology, including continued glossary
rows: Supply Chain Architected for Logistics Execution warehouse management.
Knipper’ ERP system integrating with Scale
Item Identifier for regular inventory. For Knipper, this is item code, style, color, and size.
Global Trade Item Number. Definition of an SKU in a specific Unit of Measurement (UoM).
Goods purchased by Knipper. Purchase orders and receipts have a 1:M mapping. SCALE maintains these as receipts with PO interfaced on receipt header.
A container or truck being received into the DC. One inbound trailer has one receipt.
Items needing tracking and traceability in SCALE for the source and valid paperwork.
Goods to be shipped to stores, wholesale customers, or retail supermarkets. the order in ERP and shipment in scale will be a 1:1 mapping.
A wave represents the different steps that the system uses to retrieve orders from the pool, and process them into the outbound portion of SCALE
a group of orders when processed resulting in inventory allocation
Any orders pending processing to be shipped immediately after interface to SCALE
Transaction tracked by SCALE to coordinate the movement of inventory for a variety of warehouse processes. A group of work instruction is work unit
An object that can be used to hold or transport inventory for a shipment.
An object that can be used to hold or transport inventory for a receipt.
An object that can be used to hold or transport inventory. When nested, the tree unit is referred to as the parent logistics unit.
Override Data Wave Step. SCALE provides a wave step that allows performing crud operation to data during the wave process.
An external process that performs logic in line with the base process. Used to update data or perform additional logic.
tables.normalization: Joined all 12 page-9 rows and six page-10 continuation rows; removed detector-only columns and joined printed line wraps. The Client Terminology cell beside P&D is visibly blank and remains blank. Source wording, including tree unit, is retained. No semantic cell correction was necessary.
